recommendation.why: No coupon plan for this category pays under the assumptions, even when every assumption is favourable. Use free actions, check stock and range, and learn more before any paid offer.

test_design.design: randomized: eligible households split at random into message and no-message holdout (about 10-20% holdout)
test_design.duration: 4 weeks of outcome after the message, plus the 28-day window in the outcome rule
test_design.primary_metric: incremental contribution per randomized eligible household after coupon and contact cost, 28 days

decision_rules.expand: 95% CI lower bound > 0 and all guardrails pass
decision_rules.stop: 95% CI upper bound < 0 or any guardrail fails
decision_rules.change: point estimate > 0 but CI includes 0 and guardrails pass
